chapters.label: Live: EURO 2026
chapters.text: The 2026 Futsal EURO third-place match, in Ljubljana. France play Croatia, who lead three one. Then number fourteen, Guirio, scores: one, two, three goals! It ends five all, but Croatia win on penalties.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Guirio plays pivot, back to goal. This is how he does it: a defender is right behind him. He keeps the ball close, under his foot, then turns and shoots!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Hold, keep it close, turn and shoot!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep the ball close to your body when a defender is right behind you!
